# `ExecStart*` sinks, including each element of a list: systemd takes a
# list of exec lines and every element is a line of its own.
# `ExecStartSec` is not a systemd key; the suffix set is closed.
# No env: an exec line is not shell grammar (`languages/nix:V69`).
systemd.services.web.serviceConfig.ExecStart | " | - | ${pkgs.nginx} | "${pkgs.nginx}/bin/nginx -g 'daemon off;'"
systemd.services.web.serviceConfig.ExecStartPre | " | - | ${pkgs.coreutils} | "${pkgs.coreutils}/bin/mkdir -p /run/web"
systemd.services.web.serviceConfig.ExecStartPre | " | - | ${pkgs.nginx} | "${pkgs.nginx}/bin/nginx -t"
systemd.services.web.serviceConfig.ExecStartPost | " | - | ${pkgs.coreutils} | "${pkgs.coreutils}/bin/true"
